correctness.rationale: The explicit domain is \(a\ne0\), \(r>0\), with compact invariant supports. Exact differentiation proves \(\dot\Phi=R^{2}-r^{2}\) and \(\dot\Psi=a z^{2}+x(R^{2}-r^{2})\). Invariance makes the expectation of an exact time derivative zero; testing derivatives of arbitrary scalar functions of \(\Phi\) yields the conditional expectation law. Zero transverse activity forces support in \(z=0\), then invariance and the third equation force \(R=r\). Thus all other stationary measures have strict covariance of sign opposite to \(a\), and positive mass on both radial sides. The bounded-forward time-average identity is telescoping. All polynomial identities and the explicit Hamiltonian witness were checked from the standalone source.

value.rationale: The equilibrium circle gives a natural radial reference, but a numerical chaotic portrait does not determine conditional stationary radial statistics. A nonobvious corrected-height coboundary fixes every conditional radial second moment, and a second cancellation quantifies radial skew exactly by transverse z activity, yielding a strict two-sided excursion theorem. The statements apply to all coefficients in the original natural family and a constructed nontrivial periodic orbit confirms nonvacuity. These impose usable mathematical constraints on recurrence rather than merely reciting local equilibrium geometry.
